Dress him in the superhero suit from the third image, with no face taken from it: a form-fitting teal greenish-cyan suit with dark navy panels, a high dark navy collar, broad shoulders, a dark navy cape, the mint green K emblem on his chest. Replace the room behind him completely with the scene from the second image, recomposed for a tall portrait frame: he stands on the roof of a skyscraper at dusk, the city skyline far below and behind him, and above his head BOTH moons fully in frame: the large rust crescent moon in the upper left and the small pale half moon in the upper right.
